newsitem.title: HONG KONG: North Jianshe B shares surge on results.
newsitem.headline: North Jianshe B shares surge on results.

text.p: Shenzhen North Jianshe Motorcycle Co Ltd's B shares surged to their 10 percent limit-up at HK$3.81 on Tuesday afternoon, after the firm issued better than expected 1996 results, analysts said.
"Although the results were terrible, they beat expectations as the motor industry has had a rough year," an analyst at China Southern Securities said.

Jianshe said net profits for 1996 plunged to 50.73 million yuan from 288.71 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards, while earnings per share dived to 0.11 yuan in 1996 from 0.60 yuan the year before.
"The stock is not really that hot and is unlikely to shoot up much further tomorrow," the analyst said.
The company's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.069 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 30, a Jianshe spokesman said.
